mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 enzymes, potentially increasing primaquine metabolism interference and methaemoglobin formation risk; both agents can cause oxidative stress in G6PD-deficient patients.
action: Monitor for hemolytic anemia signs (jaundice, dark urine, fatigue); verify G6PD status before primaquine use; consider separating administration times and monitoring CBC during concurrent use.
